role_label: slow-release hydrolysis agent / structure-directing sol-gel precursor
mechanism_description: TEOS acts as a molecular silica precursor that undergoes controlled hydrolysis and condensation (via acid- or base-catalyzed sol-gel reactions) to slowly release silicate species, enabling gradual, homogeneous silica network formation or coating rather than instantaneous ionic dissolution; its ethoxy groups also modulate reaction kinetics, particle size, and porosity/morphology of the resulting silica or silicate materials.
